about: The same site, the same facts and sources, in five designs. The comparison page at /designs/ shows them side by side. The default is the design at the home page.

designs.name: The Flow
designs.direction: The site drawn as one of his automations: connected steps on a canvas, from the first idea to the point where a person presses send, with three key figures at the top. Light and friendly. It is the home page.

designs.name: The Trace
designs.direction: His work shown the way his own app shows an agent: as a trace you can read step by step. Dark, monospaced and exact, for a technical reader who wants evidence.

designs.name: The Fact Sheet
designs.direction: Everything a hiring manager needs on one clean sheet, quick to scan and good on paper. White, typographic and quiet.

designs.name: The Arena
designs.direction: Loud and playful, in the spirit of the game he built: five levels, each harder than the last. Big type and colour blocks, for meetups, workshops and anyone who should remember him.

designs.name: First Pass
designs.direction: The site as the AgentiCCells site factory first wrote it: a plain header, one centred column and cards, over several pages.
